verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents automations: triggers that draft replies and organize threads, and custom AI filters written as plain-English scripts. So the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. Undo send reverts a sent email, not an automation's configuration, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
